name: Jeffrey Quesnelle
bio: Jeffrey Quesnelle is a co-founder of Nous Research, where his own site lists him as CTO, and goes by emozilla online. Quesnelle co-authored YaRN, a method for extending the context window of language models, and the Hermes 3 technical report, and holds an M.S. in computer science from the University of Michigan-Dearborn.
known_for: Co-author of the YaRN context extension method
Co-author of the Hermes 3 technical report
Earlier research on Zcash transaction anonymity
